avenger_line7: Avenger: One… two… three… hmm. That's all I can bring out, even with this, huh? Ah, well…
p196: Looking back at the ladies, he smiled evilly.
avenger_line8: Avenger: How would you girls like to play a game? It'll be loads of fun!
bazett_line13b: Bazett asked, getting in front of Amy.
p197: She took a fighting stance, trying to prepare herself for whatever new surprise that was about to be revealed.
avenger_line9b: Avenger went on, and waved at the starfish.
avenger_line10: Avenger: And you two are it! And since I'm such a nice guy, you don't have to count.
p198: The starfish began to leap away, each going in a different direction. They made odd slurping noises as they moved. It sounded like each motion they made was also them attempting to drink the air.
avenger_line12: Avenger: The game goes on until you find all three. Of course, my little babies might get hungry… and they love the taste of human flesh!
p199: Laughing, Avenger morphed into a shadow and slithered down the street light, before vanishing into the night.
bazett_line14b: Bazett ordered, and charged at one of the starfish.
bazett_line15: Bazett: We need to destroy these things before they hurt someone!
p200: Moving faster than Amy had ever seen a human move, Bazett became a not-so-blue blur as she slammed her fist into the starfish. The force of the punch created a trench in the street, and when the dust cleared, the starfish was a messy pile of dark goo.
amy_thought1b: Amy thought as she ran after another starfish.
amy_line37: Amy: I better make sure I don't get into an argument with her!
p201: Hammer raised, Amy lunged at the second starfish with intent to make an ugly pancake. She slammed her hammer down, but partially missed. Her blow only struck one of the creature's legs, flattening it instantly. The thing writhed in pain for only a moment, before the broken limb fell off, and a new appendage grew in its place. Only this second leg looked like something that belonged to a kraken.
amy_line38b: Amy shrieked, and slammed her hammer down again.
p202: She wasn't fast enough, and the abomination was able to zip away from her weapon. Amy chased after it, but the horror was faster now, and quickly zipped up the side of a building. Panicking, Amy ran up to a fire hydrant and swung her hammer. The hydrant went flying, and managed to slam into the creature, knocking it off of the building.
p203: Amy charged, and once close enough brought her hammer down on the beast several times. She didn't stop until the horror was a gooey black paste.
amy_line39b: Amy gagged, and scraped her hammer against the sidewalk to wipe the gunk off.
amy_line40: Amy: Okay, that's two down, where's the third…?
p204: She looked around and saw that she was the only one on the street.
p205: She heard a crash in the distance.
audio_title15: Fate_stay night [Réalta Nua] OST - THIS ILLUSION (inst.) (2012 Remaster)
p206: The fight between Sonic and Lancer had reached a stalemate, not that either one was willing to admit it. Although Sonic was far faster and more willing to use unorthodox tactics (like causing a fire hydrant to explode in Lancer's face), Lancer was almost as fast, had magic abilities, and a long spear. And then there was that really awkward incident when Lancer sent him flying into that apartment window…
p207: Sonic crashed through the glass, and the second thing he heard besides the tinkling was a woman screaming. Looking up, he saw that he was now in someone's bedroom. A mature and attractive woman was desperately shaking the prone form of a young man, who simply snored off her actions.
femme2_line1: Woman: KOUTA! There's a tanuki in our bedroom, wake up!
p208: Sonic plucked a piece of glass out of his fur and scooped his Rings back up.
sonic_line39: Sonic: No, there's not. You're having a bad dream.
p209: Sonic turned towards the window before turning back.
sonic_line40: Sonic: Also, I'm a hedgehog, not a tanuki.
p210: He turned back towards the window, then glanced over his shoulder.
sonic_line41: Sonic: If you wake up and the window's still broken, just go see the priest at the local church. I think he's good for it.
p211: Sonic was pretty sure that Shirou said the guy at the church (what was his name, Kotofin or something?) would take care of any damage caused in the War. That probably meant he could pay for broken stuff thanks to a budget he got from whatever secret organization that was in charge of that sort of thing.
p212: Sonic bounced off of the walls, swung around street signs and lights, keeping one step ahead of Lancer and taking a shot of his own whenever a chance arose. Such openings didn't appear easily. Lancer had evidently learned from their first fight. He wasn't letting up and giving Sonic a chance to move in for another hit. This didn't mean the spearman didn't slip up and make mistakes of his own, it just meant Sonic had to be really observant and quick to take advantage of them. The first wasn't something he was known for, but the second came as natural as breathing.
p213: A favorite tactic Sonic had discovered was standing against a wall, allowing Lancer to charge at him, before dodging at the last minute and hitting the Servant with a Homing Shot. The precious half-second Lancer had his spear stuck in a building was plenty for Sonic to chip at the Heroic Spirit's hit points.
sonic_thought3: Sonic: Weird how Masters can see a Servant's stats…
p214: Sonic thought, thinking back to what Shirou and Saber told him their first night together. He shot back to avoid Lancer's retaliation.
sonic_thought4: Sonic: Makes you wonder if whoever started these stupid Wars was a D&D nerd…
p215: As Sonic prepared to run off and put a bit more distance between himself and Lancer, he stopped. This caused Lancer to stop as well, wondering if this hesitation was part of some new plan.
p216: Lancer's brain stalled, and when it reignited, he just shook his head sadly. In spite of Sonic's taunts and tricks, he had grown to respect the Hedgehog somewhat. All of that respect was now gone.
lancer_line10: Lancer: Are you really going to try that gag? I mean, that was old even during my human years. I-
p217: That was as far as Lancer got before a horrible, starfish-thing-with-tentacles tackled him and latched onto his face. The Heroic Spirit fell to the ground, rolling and writhing as he tried to pull it off.
p218a: Sonic blinked. As warped and disturbing the scene before him technically was, he had actually seen far creepier things during his adventures, including but not limited to the
p218c: split open his planet. In fact, the Aliens shout-out taking place didn't even make the top-ten. The idea that whatever was attacking Lancer came from another Servant came to mind, so Sonic decided to invoke a tactical retreat.
sonic_line43: Sonic: Y'know what, you're probably busy right now.
p219: Sonic said cheerfully, and began to walk off.
sonic_line44: Sonic: Let's finish this some other time.
p220: Sonic zipped off. Three seconds later, he came back, and took a picture of Lancer's pain with the cell phone. And then he ran off. A minute later, Lancer managed to rip the abomination away from his face and throw it onto the pavement. Before it could crawl away, he stabbed the Gae Bolg into it several times, before stomping on its remains for good measure. Once he was done, Lancer spat onto the ground.
lancer_line12: Lancer: Gah, I'll be tasting that for a week!
p221: Lancer moaned, wiping the beast's residue from his face. His eyes shot open with realization.
p222: Lancer ran off in the direction he thought Sonic went in. It wasn't, and Sonic managed to return to the Emiya Estate in the hopes that a late-night game of Aero the Acro-Bat would undo the sight of a little sea monster trying to make out with Lancer. Moments passed, and the street was quiet again… except for the creature's remains, which made odd squelching sounds as it tried to reassert its life and mobility.
p223: Bazett soon appeared, having followed after the creature. It hadn't been easy, but the sound of someone screaming helped her find it. She was surprised to see that the last of the abominations had been wounded, and a quick usage of Magecraft ensured its death.
amy_line43: Amy: Bazett, did you find it?
bazett_line16b: Bazett replied, gesturing towards the smoldering ashes.
bazett_line17: Bazett: What was left of it, at least.
amy_line44: Amy: What do you- Whoa! What happened here?
amy_line44b: Amy cried, having finally taken stock of her surroundings.
p225: A fire hydrant and a newsstand had been knocked over. The area looked like a small war had broken out.
bazett_line18: Bazett: I think there were Servants battling here.
bazett_line19: Bazett: I can sense traces of Magecraft.
bazett_line20: Bazett: It could have been Lancer… or it could have been any other Servant.
bazett_line21: Bazett: In any case, I think the creature that person conjured up is similar to a Servant.
bazett_line22: Bazett: A Servant can only exist in the world due to the Mana they receive from their Master.
bazett_line23: Bazett: The same principle exists for other types of summons. I believe that creature came here to find a source of Mana to sustain itself.
amy_line48: Amy: You mean it was going to eat someone? Gross!
amy_line48b: Amy shuddered at the thought, then looked thoughtful.
amy_line49: Amy: Hold on, was that creepy Emerald thief… was he a Servant?
p226: What Bazett didn't say was that the man who took the purple gem and conjured those creatures had a fouler Mana than the one she felt when she summoned Lancer. Servants summoned by the Grail came from the Throne of Heroes; how could a being with such a terrible presence end up there? And from what part of history did his legend spring forth?
p227: Strange animal spirits from another world. A madman with an army of destructive robots. Servants appearing in public. And now this. By that point, all Bazett could ask was:
p228: High up on a tall building, Avenger looked down on the city of Fuyuki. He saw it all. The Servant Rider, stalking victims, but taking care not to be seen. The Servant Lancer, fruitlessly searching for his Hedgehog nemesis. The Servant Saber, accompanying her own Master back to their abode, where the blue Hedgehog waited. And among them, thousands of normal people, only vaguely aware of the danger they were all in.
p229: In another timeline, they would have all been targets, potential victims to be consumed. But not here. Not now.
p230: He felt the Chaos Emerald inside his body, its power seeping into every atom of his being. It wouldn't be long. A few days, a week, perhaps? And then, he would have what he needed.
p231: And his wish would be granted.

taiga_line1: Taiga: You asked for it! You wanted it! You deserve it! It's the Tiger Dojo! I am your instructor, Fujimura Taiga!
illya_line1: Illya: And the Number One Student, Illya, is here as well!
taiga_line2: Taiga: The first of the seven Chaos Emeralds has been found! Unfortunately, it's now in the hands of that lunatic, Avenger.
illya_line2: Illya: You'd think an Enforcer for the Mage's Association would have better luck securing a powerful artifact, wouldn't you? What a disappointment.
taiga_line3: Taiga: But there is plenty of time for her to redeem herself. After all, they don't let weak-willed people into that Association.
illya_line3: Illya: They let Rin's ancestors, didn't they?
taiga_line4: Taiga: Don't be mean! Anyway, we've got a Q&A to start! Read the first question!
illya_line4c: Hey, I thought we said no more spoiler-y questions!
taiga_line5: Taiga: We're not going to change that policy, no matter how cute your name is! However, I will keep track of the Emerald locations we have confirmed so far:
taiga_line5b: The yellow Chaos Emerald is underneath Shirou's shed. Nobody's claimed it yet.
taiga_line5c: The purple Chaos Emerald is now inside of Avenger. Yuck!
illya_line5a: Illya: Speaking of Avenger, we have a question about him from Chuckie:
illya_line5b: "How did Avenger summon those starfish things? That's not a power he had in the original visual novel."
illya_line5c: Oh, Chuck, you dumb, dumb guy.
taiga_line6: Taiga: The Avenger we're seeing now is actually the Shadow from the Heaven's Feel route, with Hollow Ataraxia's personality. In the Heaven's Feel, that Shadow could recreate evil versions of the Servants it absorbed throughout that route. The creatures Avenger created in this story are actually by-products of something that was already absorbed by its previous form… but that's a story for another day. One last question!
illya_line6b: "Due to Shirou absorbing some of the yellow Chaos Emerald's power, have his magic circuits been upgraded, healed, powered up, etc?"
illya_line6c: Signed: Anonymous. Finally, a non-stupid question. When Onii-chan used Projection near the Emerald, he did take in some of its power. But I wouldn't say that he's been powered up, or anything. Because of his lousy skills, Onii-chan's have actually gotten worse! Of course, that might change once Rin gives him a proper lesson in Magecraft. Though, if he wanted to learn from an expert, he'd ditch her and come to me.
taiga_line7: Taiga: Also, a special announcement! The author has created an opening sequence for this story! It's posted on Youtube, under the title "Fate/Genesis OP (Fanmade)"! Be sure to check it out!
illya_line7: Illya: The sound isn't very good, but if you can do better, give it a try!
taiga_line8: Taiga: Until then, we will see you at the next practice!
